headline.zh: 为餐厅配置 AI 运营助手
headline.en: Configure AI operating assistant for restaurant

scenario.zh: 你经营一家意大利餐厅，需要 AI 助手处理订单、库存和排班
scenario.en: You run an Italian restaurant and need an AI assistant to handle orders, inventory and scheduling

instruction.zh: 从最耗时的运营环节开始
instruction.en: Start with the most time-consuming operation

output.zh: 看板显示 AI 接听模块，自动记录菜品、过敏信息和取餐时间
output.en: Board shows AI call module capturing dishes, allergies and pickup times

output.zh: 看板显示库存卡片，AI 根据菜单用量预测补货需求
output.en: Board shows inventory cards with AI predicting restock needs from menu usage

instruction.zh: 定义 AI 助手的决策边界
instruction.en: Define decision boundaries for AI assistant

output.zh: AI 直接确认标准订单，标记特殊要求供人工审核
output.en: AI confirms standard orders directly, flags special requests for review

output.zh: AI 整理信息草稿，所有决定由店长最终批准
output.en: AI prepares information drafts, manager approves all decisions

instruction.zh: 检查 AI 在晚高峰的实际表现
instruction.en: Check AI performance during evening rush

output.zh: 42 通来电中 39 单完整记录，3 单因方言转人工
output.en: 39 of 42 calls recorded completely, 3 transferred due to dialect

output.zh: 番茄和罗勒预测与实际用量接近，帕尔马干酪略有偏差
output.en: Tomato and basil predictions close to actual usage, Parmesan slightly off

instruction.zh: 根据日志优化下周运营
instruction.en: Optimize next week's operations based on log

output.zh: 看板新增排班卡片，AI 基于历史客流推荐周末人员安排
output.en: Board adds shift cards, AI recommends weekend staffing from traffic history

output.zh: 看板显示供应商对接状态，AI 可直接生成采购清单草稿
output.en: Board shows supplier integration status, AI drafts purchase lists directly

takeaway.zh: 垂直场景的 AI agent 通过明确规则和日志反馈持续优化餐厅运营
takeaway.en: Vertical AI agents optimize restaurant operations through clear rules and log feedback
